crosswalks.historical_boundary: Bagan Archaeological Zone / classical Bagan plain, approximately 104 km2, centered on the walled capital and monument landscape.
crosswalks.boundary_confidence: high for property boundary; low for rural food catchment
crosswalks.resolution_method: Use the pagan location only as a containing selector and cap the mapped footprint at the UNESCO archaeological property area. The city/property boundary is deliberately not expanded to Kyaukse, Mu valley, or the Pagan Kingdom.
crosswalks.notes: The crosswalk is suitable for physical feature validation, but the city/trade-hub boundary rule blocks demographic training use. No population value is inferred from monument density.
